learningObjectives: Understand accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score
Select appropriate evaluation metrics for different scenarios

activities.title: Confusion Matrix Anatomy
activities.instruction: Click each cell to identify the prediction outcome.

content.concept: A confusion matrix organizes classification results into true positives, true negatives, false positives, and false negatives.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: The model predicts positive and the actual outcome is positive.
The model predicts negative and the actual outcome is negative.
The model predicts positive but the actual outcome is negative.
The model predicts negative but the actual outcome is positive.

activities.title: Metric Explorer
activities.instruction: Adjust prediction outcomes and observe metric changes.

content.concept: Accuracy measures overall correctness, while precision, recall, and F1-score focus on different types of classification performance.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Choose the Metric
activities.instruction: Match each scenario with a useful evaluation metric.

content.concept: Metric choice depends on which prediction errors matter most for the application.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Evaluation Pipeline
activities.instruction: Build the flow from predictions to performance metrics.

content.concept: Evaluation compares model predictions with known outcomes and converts errors into measurable performance indicators.
